title: SQL Intermediate
description: 20 intermediate SQL Server interview problems covering subqueries, CTEs, window functions, complex JOINs, and set operations.
longDescription: This module covers intermediate SQL topics essential for senior roles. Problems include subqueries, CTEs, window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG), EXISTS, UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT, and complex multi-table JOINs.
whatYouLearn: Use CTEs for recursive and non-recursive queries
Apply window functions for ranking and analytics
Combine result sets with UNION, INTERSECT, and EXCEPT
